Web Design

Web design in Australia, built to rank and convert.

Web design at Nifty Websites Australia is the strategic design and build of business websites that are made to rank in search, convert visitors into enquiries and grow with your business. Every build is mobile-first, fast, and includes a complete SEO build set up for you at launch.

Get a Free Quote See how it works
$2,000SEO build included
on every website, free.
Why Nifty

Design that earns its keep, not just good looks.

Good design is where it starts. We build websites that are found on Google, guide visitors to act, and are easy for you to run.

Strategy first

We plan around your customers and the searches they use before a single pixel is placed.

Built to convert

Clear calls to action, fast pages and honest proof so more visitors become enquiries.

SEO built in

Every site ships with a complete SEO build, so you are visible from launch, not months later.

Mobile-first

Most of your visitors are on a phone. We design for the small screen first, then scale up.

Fast and secure

Lean, secure builds that load quickly and stay stable, which both users and Google reward.

Australian support

A local team you can actually reach, with care plans to keep your site healthy.

Recent work

Websites that work.

What we build

Web design services for every stage.

Explore the right build for your business, or ask us and we will point you to the best fit.

  • Small Business WebsitesAffordable, high-converting sites for growing businesses.
  • eCommerce WebsitesWooCommerce and Shopify stores built to sell.
  • Custom WebsitesBespoke design and functionality for unique needs.
  • Website RedesignModernise an ageing site without losing your rankings.
  • Landing PagesFocused pages built to convert paid and campaign traffic.
How it works

From brief to launch, a clear process.

Discover

We learn your business, your customers and the searches that matter.

Design

We design a mobile-first layout around conversion and your brand.

Build and optimise

We build fast, add your SEO build, and test on real devices.

Launch and grow

We launch, connect tracking, and support you with care plans.

Common questions

Web design questions, answered.

How much does a website cost in Australia?

Cost depends on the number of pages and features you need. We provide a fixed, itemised quote after a short discovery chat, so you know the full price before any work begins. See our pricing page for guidance.

Do you build the site to rank on Google?

Yes. Every website includes a complete SEO build, covering optimised content, schema markup, technical setup and Search Console and Analytics, so you are positioned to rank from launch.

Can you redesign my existing website?

Yes. We modernise ageing sites while protecting the pages and URLs that already rank, so a redesign grows your results rather than resetting them.

Do you work with businesses outside the big cities?

Yes. We are an Australian team supporting businesses Australia-wide, with local web design pages for cities and regional towns across the country.

Get started

Ready for a website that works?

Tell us about your project and we will come back with a fixed price and honest advice. No obligation.

Private and secure. We reply within one business day.

Let us build you a website that earns its place.

Get a free, no obligation quote with the $2,000 SEO build included on every website we make.
